Requirements: VERIFY: For every field I documented — did I SEE it in a browser_snapshot? Which snapshot proves it?
COUNT: Fields in my REQUIREMENTS section vs fields visible on the live page. Do they match exactly?
SCAN: Search my additions for: TBD, TODO, DISCOVER_, assumption, placeholder. Resolve each hit or remove.
SCOPE: Am I documenting fields from a different tab/submodule? Check scope boundaries.
EVIDENCE: Did I trigger actual validation errors on live UI, or did I guess the rules from field names?
Planner: COUNT: Fields visible in my latest browser_snapshot = ___. TCs in my file = ___. Do they match? If not, justify each gap.
SCAN: Search my TC file for: TBD, may be, if exists, or, to be confirmed, placeholder. Every hit must be resolved or removed.
CERTIFY: For each uiTestingChecklist boolean I marked true — name the specific TC ID that exercises it. If none exists, set false.
DIFF: Pick 3 random TC Steps. Open my Test Plan. Does the TC accurately summarize the plan, or did I introduce shortcuts/errors?
SELECTORS: For each TC that references a selector — does that exact selector key exist in src/selectors/index.ts?
SCOPE: Am I including any fields or tabs that belong to a different submodule? Check feature boundaries.
LIVE: Did I verify field behavior on the LIVE site via browser_snapshot, or did I just read REQUIREMENTS.md and assume?
Generator: GREP: Search my spec file for: page., ['page'], Log., hardcoded CSS selectors (# or . literals). Every hit is a violation — fix it.
RAN: Did I actually execute npx playwright test <my-spec> and see a PASS line in terminal? Paste the evidence.
PATTERN: Count tests that follow identical patterns (e.g., check/uncheck N checkboxes). If 3+, refactor to for...of with data array.
IMPORTS: Does my spec import ONLY from ../../setup/fixtures? No custom fixture files, no init-session, no direct @playwright/test.
SIZE: Is my spec under 200 lines? If over, extract test data to a constant or JSON file.
HEADERS: Does my spec have // spec: and // seed: header comments? Verify exact format.
Healer: ROOT CAUSE: Does my fix address the ROOT CAUSE, or just the symptom? What evidence proves root cause?
RAN: Did I run the test after my fix and see actual PASS output? Paste the terminal evidence.
CLEANUP: Are there any test.fixme() or .skip() markers I should remove now that the fix works?
ISOLATION: Could my fix break other tests? Check for shared state, selectors used elsewhere, data mutations.
LOG: Does my activity log entry accurately describe what I changed and why?
Audit: STALE: Am I re-checking my own prior block claims, or blindly carrying them forward? Re-verify each.
GREP: Did I search for DISCOVER_ placeholders before declaring pipeline clean?
EVIDENCE: Does every finding cite file:line evidence, or am I making claims from memory?
RECONCILE: TC count in test plan vs TC count in file vs queue notes — do all three match?
OVERCRITICISM: Am I fabricating issues to fill a quota? L3 check: would a senior QA agree these are real?
